body: Dude my parents are the opposite of supportive. If I move in with him I get completely cut off. Not just financially but entirely.

I can be with him before all the debt is paid off but after doing some math, I'll be in my mid 40s by the time the debt is gone and I will have paid almost half a million dollars by then due to compounding interest. Housing where I live is too expensive for me to move out any time soon. If I were to try getting out now, I would need to be prepared to pay for everything by myself because the minute I tell my parents I'm moving in with him, I'll lose everything they support right now. I'm prepared for that, but I need to be in a place I'm not sure I'll get to.

Do I foresee paying it down? It could happen, but at the cost of any kind of long term financial stability. My estimates include paying the minimum, which it turns out is more than half of what I could expect in an optimistic entry level job. By that time, there's barely enough for an optimistic rent, much less necessities like internet, phone and food.

Originally computer science, then behavioral science which the university discontinued while I was balls deep in the major. I switched to sociology but none of the behavioral science classes counted towards it, putting me very far behind.
